selection_rule: Six DPRM-only wins selected after the paired aggregate audit to cover distinct arithmetic failure modes. Case 159 is the main-paper representative; cases 284, 1209, 246, 908, and 50 appear in the supplement. The project page shows all six.
metric_use: The gallery is qualitative pipeline-level interpretation. The main-paper and supplement case sets are disjoint. Aggregate claims use all 1319 paired examples, and the same-checkpoint decoder probe is reported separately.
